description: Apply simulated annealing to search the space of 6-state TMs. The energy function is based on simulation length and sigma score. Temperature schedule allows escaping local optima.
mathematical_formalization: E(M) = -log(sigma(M)); P(accept worse) = exp(-dE/T); T(t) = T_0 * alpha^t
implementation_hypothesis: Start from random TNF machine, propose single-transition mutations, accept based on Metropolis criterion with sigma score as energy
experiment_seed: Run SA for 100K iterations from 10 different random seeds, track best machines found
